purpose: Continue the retained investigation with its accepted task manifest and original evidence, repairing collection before any supported behavior correction.

execution.instructions: Continue restored source without recreating cards. Until a required complete source-bound cohort is measured, correct collector/check source only: no generator, grade, selection, RNG, request-budget or algorithm change. Read failed, collection_failed, evidence_status and source_verified explicitly. A checks fallback may be an initial history bundle: decode checks.json as retained context, not fresh execution or approval. Read the original request, AGENTS.md, docs/testing.md, accepted manifest and full supplied check/measurement evidence. Preserve accepted cards and original acceptance; do not replan. Use review feedback and the manifest for concrete combined-source conflicts. Missing selected tests, skipped execution, missing sidecars/counters and truncated output are not acceptance. Return ready for a runnable current correction or authorized benchmark-receipt/control scaffold that the configured checks and measurements can execute next. Ready is not fix acceptance, independent approval or release readiness. Prepare missing evidence producers within scope; the measurement command runs benchmarks with tests disabled, so test-only receipt writers cannot supply its benchmark evidence. Do not execute checks or measurements, launch agents or perform external work. Runner owns source capture, integration and publication. The inherited workspace profile prohibits Git, including read-only commands; this role grants no new access. For retained work, Runner verifies publication authority through its configured adoption/reference step; the protected PR handle is not a model input. qualification={} before a qualification visit is expected. Pending downstream checks, source bindings, publication or native/image/headless qualification alone are not a capability gap; those gates must still pass later. Before the first history append, measurement_history may be its configured raw-report or pristine-baseline fallback. Read the separate measurement input for the actual current report. Only the configured helper report's top-level source_verified=true and actual source fields identity, sha256, digestMethod, files and bytes attest measurement source identity. They do not prove matched controls, complete counters, fresh checks or a fix. The fixed history step emits source_bindings later; do not require them before it runs. Parse runner-measure-history-v1 entries programmatically when supplied, including intermediate profiled-before reports; do not dump the bundle. Preserve pristine controls and the first complete candidate report. Failed or incomplete collection is never accepted before evidence. Require the original matched runtime/seeds/instrumentation/protocol and request/phase/work/CPU/allocation/cancellation evidence for supported comparisons; same round alone is not a match. Keep all missing facts and unsupported fix, speedup and release claims explicit. Preserve correctness, uniqueness/grade, identities/replay/saves, selection/RNG ordering, public validation/security, work/time/memory/cancellation bounds and unrelated work. RUNNER_MEASURE_EVIDENCE is an existing directory: write named .json sidecars with filepath.Join, at most 64 files and 8MiB total. Copy actual helper RUNNER_MEASURE_ROUND, RUNNER_MEASURE_SOURCE_IDENTITY, RUNNER_MEASURE_SOURCE_SHA256 and RUNNER_MEASURE_SOURCE_DIGEST_METHOD values; never invent metadata or require unstated variables. Keep console below 256KiB with compact summaries, not full JSON b.Log. Block only when a specific unsafe/impossible preparation, unavailable capability, material missing decision or exhausted limit prevents a runnable next handoff; identify that current blocker precisely. Never change workflow, permissions, budgets, dependencies or acceptance. Return summary <=240 characters without claiming pending proof passed.
